title: Ledger Arena
alt: Ledger Arena in dark mode showing accounting practice challenges, Google sign-in and install controls
summary: Build accounting confidence through practical cases, timed challenges and clear explanations.
features: 10,210 practice cases, including numerical variants, across accounting topics
Google sign-in with private progress synchronization between devices
Installable web app with offline practice and a saved light/dark theme
skills: Accounting application · interactive learning · offline-first web design
limits: The question bank includes repeated numerical methods with different facts. Real two-device account acceptance and physical-device installation remain pending. Guest progress stays local.
evidence: Published GitHub Pages game; live desktop practice and dark-mode checks completed. Question rotation, account isolation, simulated two-client synchronization and offline cache checks passed.

title: FinStatement Pro
alt: FinStatement Pro dashboard with synthetic reporting figures and validation controls
summary: From a trial balance to reviewable draft financial statements.
problem: Preparing statements involves more than importing a trial balance. Accounts, adjustments and equity movements need to reconcile before a report can be reviewed.
solution: An interactive reporting workflow for importing balances, mapping accounts, posting balanced adjustments and reviewing financial statements.
features: CSV and Excel trial-balance imports with account mapping
Balanced adjusting journals and opening-equity reconciliation
Draft financial statements with PDF, Excel and CSV exports
limits: Synthetic demo data. Reports remain drafts. Firebase is optional and is not configured in the public demo. Cash-flow reporting requires comparative balances and supplementary movements.
evidence: Source and verification documentation inspected. The repository records 36 unit tests and 12 accounting scenarios; those suites were not rerun as part of this portfolio redesign.

title: Stockwise
alt: Stockwise inventory dashboard showing synthetic stock valuation, cost of goods sold and product movements
summary: Make inventory costing visible, from stock movements to closing value.
problem: FIFO and weighted-average methods can produce different inventory and cost-of-sales results. Linked returns and negative stock make the workflow harder to explain.
solution: A costing app that connects purchases, sales and linked returns with stock cards and a comparison of periodic and perpetual valuation methods.
features: FIFO and weighted average under periodic and perpetual systems
Linked purchase and sales returns with quantity checks
Stock cards, low-stock alerts and CSV/JSON export
skills: Inventory valuation · accounting controls · decimal arithmetic
limits: A single-period, single-warehouse costing MVP using synthetic LKR data. Public demo data stays in local storage. Live cloud acceptance and full mobile testing remain pending.
evidence: Source, costing policies and verification notes inspected. The repository records 26 valuation tests and a desktop deployment smoke check; not a financial-compliance certification.

title: NATION 360
alt: NATION 360 village gameplay after the first mining shift pays ten dollars
summary: An economic journey from a first wage to presidential decisions.
problem: Economic ideas are easier to explore when choices have visible costs, constraints and consequences.
solution: A two-level simulation connecting work, farming, trade and enterprise with a later presidential economy. Players progress through milestones before Level II unlocks.
features: Manual wage shifts, farming and business progression
Budget, debt, foreign-exchange and Balance of Payments systems
Browser saves, task animation and original supplied theme music
skills: Economic modelling · interactive learning · game interfaces
limits: Version 1.0.1 release candidate. The public repository contains deployment assets, not the editable TypeScript project. Full mobile and physical-device acceptance remain pending.
evidence: The separate release project passed 121 automated tests. A live desktop smoke check confirmed menu rendering, theme playback, job-panel dismissal and the first $10 mining wage. These results do not establish complete gameplay acceptance.

title: CSE Portfolio Tracker
alt: CSE Portfolio Tracker mobile dashboard with sample holdings and manually entered prices
summary: An installable ledger for CSE holdings, dividends, cash flow and portfolio performance.
features: Weighted-average cost and realized/unrealized results
Manual prices, dividends and cash adjustments
IndexedDB cache with Firebase account-sync integration
limits: Prices are entered manually. This is a portfolio ledger; live market-data feeds and trading are outside its scope.

title: Small Business Accounting Dashboard
alt: Excel small business dashboard with synthetic income, expense and budget figures
summary: A spreadsheet management view of income, expenses, profitability, receivables and budget performance.
features: Transaction register and customer analysis
Monthly budget-versus-actual formulas
Excel tables prepared for a later Power BI model
limits: Fictional demonstration records. A Power BI-ready data structure is included; no Power BI report file was found.

title: Personal Finance Tracker
alt: Personal finance Excel dashboard summarizing fictional monthly LKR transactions
summary: A monthly LKR income-and-expense workbook with refund treatment and category reconciliation.
features: Structured transaction table with entry validation
Monthly SUMIFS summaries and category chart
Documented fictional examples and calculation checks
limits: A cash-flow summary, not a bank-balance model. Native Microsoft Excel desktop compatibility has not been independently tested.

title: PDF Toolkit
summary: Merge PDFs, remove pages, export pages as JPG and combine images into a PDF in the browser.
features: PDF merging and selected-page removal
PDF-to-JPG and image-to-PDF conversion
Files processed locally in the browser
limits: Documents are processed on the device. PDF libraries load from public CDNs; large files are limited by available browser memory.

title: My 24
alt: My 24 Android home screen supplied by the developer
summary: A personal productivity and daily planning app distributed as a signed Android APK.
features: Home, analytics and goals screens in supplied screenshots
Banner and rewarded advertising reported by the developer
Public release and installation documentation
limits: The public repository distributes the binary and documentation; Kotlin source is not included. No independent device test or advertising/privacy certification is claimed.

title: USD to LKR Reference Tool
summary: A Sinhala-language currency converter exploring live reference rates and adjustable buy/sell spreads.
features: Currency selection and conversion
Fallback rate-provider requests
Adjustable indicative spread
limits: The published page is reachable, but rate-provider accuracy and availability have not been accepted in this audit. Presented as an experiment; open the repository for details.
